notes.title: About demo version
notes.notes:
Because of the restriction of Steam system, you can not download demo version on Steam after purchasing retail version.
So demo version is also available on another website.

 Project ONe Demo version 
Click "ダウンロード"

notes.title: Demo version
notes.notes:
Demo version exists.
If the demo does not run on your pc, the retail version may not run.
So you should try demo before buying.
